items.title: Thread resolved gitCwd into the DONE-oracle git-status path (fix the wrapper-root DONE false-block)
items.context: Resolve gitCwd once at the runDonePreMergeGate boundary (transition-orchestrator.ts already computes doneGitCwd ~:271 — pass it instead of bare ctx.root at ~:363; or resolve inside runDonePreMergeGate) and thread it through done-effects.ts runDoneOracleGate -> core/done-oracle.ts buildDoneChecklist -> readGitStatusLines so `git status` runs from the resolved gitRoot. Fall back to root when no gitRoot resolves (plain repos byte-identical). done-oracle.ts currently has no resolveGitCwd import. Verify with a wrapper-root scenario that the 'git-working-tree' done-check row no longer false-fails when metadataRoot != gitRoot.
items.userSees: On a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot != gitRoot), `lattice story_advance --phase=DONE` no longer false-fails the git-working-tree DONE check with 'unable to read git status'; the DONE-oracle reads git status from the gitRoot. Plain repos are unchanged.

happy.desc: On a wrapper-root fixture (metadataRoot != gitRoot), buildDoneChecklist git-working-tree row reads clean instead of fail/blocking after threading doneGitCwd through runDonePreMergeGate->runDoneOracleGate->buildDoneChecklist->readGitStatusLines

edge.desc: On a plain repo (projectRoot==gitCwd, no distinct gitRoot), the git-working-tree row + all done-oracle git calls are byte-identical before/after (root fallback preserves behavior)

adversarial.desc: resolveGitCwd is resolved ONCE at the boundary (the same doneGitCwd at transition-orchestrator:271 used by autoSync) and passed down — not re-resolved divergently inside the gate; lattice validate stays green

verificationEvidence.note: Wrapper-root smoke: with resolved gitCwd (real gitRoot) the git-working-tree done-check row reads clean/pass; red baseline (bare metadataRoot) was fail/blocking in the same run. Witness: neutering the fix flipped GREEN assertion to status=fail detail=fatal: not a git repository.

Plain-repo byte-identity: smoke proof drives buildDoneChecklist on a plain repo (metadataRoot==gitRoot) with gitCwd absent vs {gitCwd:root} and assert.deepEqual on the full row set + git-working-tree row — identical (root fallback preserves behavior).

doneGitCwd resolved ONCE at transition-orchestrator (the SAME value used by autoSyncMain:298 + checkMainDivergence:295) and threaded into runDonePreMergeGate(...,doneGitCwd) at :371 — no re-resolution inside the gate chain (preMortem #4). lattice validate --story=B-6666 PASS.

items.title: Thread resolved gitCwd into evidence-freshness git probes
items.context: core/evidence-freshness.ts uses a no-op `const gitCwd = projectRoot` alias with no resolveGitCwd import; its authority/done callers pass bare metadataRoot, so on wrapper-root the freshness/material hashes come back undefined. Thread the resolved gitCwd into the evidence-freshness git probes (resolve at the caller boundary or accept a gitCwd param), falling back to root. Keep plain-repo behavior byte-identical.
items.userSees: On a wrapper-root project, evidence-freshness / authority-receipt material hashes resolve correctly (not undefined) because the git probes run from the gitRoot; plain repos unchanged.

happy.desc: On a wrapper-root fixture, evidence-freshness git probes (currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash via checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit) return defined hashes instead of undefined after the resolved gitCwd is threaded into the probes (caller boundary or gitCwd param), so the done-path evidence-freshness row is computed against the real gitRoot

edge.desc: On a plain repo, currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/changedFilesBetween results are byte-identical before/after (root fallback)

adversarial.desc: The done-path evidence-freshness caller (buildDoneChecklist:280 checkEvidenceFreshness) receives the SAME resolved gitCwd as the git-status row (no split-brain between the two done-oracle git reads); validate green

verificationEvidence.note: Wrapper-root smoke: evidence-freshness probes (currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash via checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit) return DEFINED hashes against the resolved inner gitRoot; bare metadataRoot returned undefined (red baseline in same run).
Plain-repo probe byte-identity: currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash outputs identical bare-root vs resolved gitCwd (root fallback).

done-oracle.ts:280 checkEvidenceFreshness receives the SAME buildDoneChecklist-threaded resolved gitCwd as the git-status row — no split-brain. Confessional comment + no-op aliases removed from evidence-freshness.ts (grep returns 0). validate PASS.

items.title: Strengthen the gitroot-cwd contract to close the alias + backtick-template blind spots, and make it GREEN
items.context: In tasks/gitroot-cwd-contract-smoke.ts: (a) detect the no-op-alias defect — a `const <name> = projectRoot|root|metadataRoot` (or equivalent) that is then used as a git-call cwd without going through resolveGitCwd should be flagged, so B-db56's d93b69b8f-style silencing is caught; (b) extend GIT_CALL_REGEX (or add a second scan) to cover backtick-template `execSync(\`git ...\`)` call sites (~15 exist, 6 with literal bare-root cwd). Then FIX every real bare-root site the strengthened contract flags (thread resolveGitCwd / fall back to root). Run `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` and confirm it EXITS 0 — the gate does not run it today, so verify explicitly. If the backtick blast radius exceeds what this story can safely fix, fix the confirmed wrapper-root sites + ship the alias-detection rule and explicitly log the remaining sites as a documented follow-up (do not leave the contract red).
items.userSees: `npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract` exits 0 AND now fails if someone re-introduces a `const gitCwd = projectRoot` alias or a backtick-template git call with a bare-root cwd — the contract can no longer be silenced without routing through resolveGitCwd.

happy.desc: After strengthening, npm run test:gitroot-cwd-contract exits 0 and prints the passed banner, with all confirmed bare-root sites fixed (done-oracle + evidence-freshness now route through resolveGitCwd)

edge.desc: A KNOWN-BAD self-test fixture: a no-op const gitCwd=projectRoot alias used as a git cwd WITHOUT resolveGitCwd produces exactly 1 violation; a KNOWN-GOOD fixture (alias not used as git cwd, OR routed via resolveGitCwd) produces 0 violations — alias rule pinned both ways

adversarial.desc: A KNOWN-BAD self-test fixture: a backtick-template execSync(`git ...`) with cwd:projectRoot is flagged (the old GIT_CALL_REGEX backtick blind spot is closed); reintroducing either gaming shape (the exact d93b69b8f alias) turns the contract RED

verificationEvidence.note: Contract exits 0 (GREEN): repo scan 520 .ts files 0 bare-cwd violations; done-oracle + evidence-freshness now route through resolveGitCwd; deferred sites documented in DEFERRED_ALLOWLIST_EXACT with B-99b6 burndown follow-up, original B-db56 literal-git coverage preserved for them via isOldRegexVisible.

ALIAS rule pinned both ways via self-tests: KNOWN-BAD (const gitCwd=projectRoot used as git cwd, no resolveGitCwd) -> exactly 1 alias violation; KNOWN-GOOD #1 (const x=projectRoot NOT used as git cwd) -> 0 (proximity-scoped, preMortem #3); KNOWN-GOOD #2 (const gitCwd=resolveGitCwd(...) used as git cwd) -> 0. All three assertions pass in the smoke.

BACKTICK rule pinned: KNOWN-BAD backtick execSync(`git status`,{cwd:projectRoot}) -> exactly 1 bare violation (old backtick blind spot closed); KNOWN-GOOD backtick with cwd:resolvedGitCwd -> 0. LIVE RED->GREEN witness: reintroduced the exact d93b69b8f shape (const witnessGitCwd=projectRoot used as cwd of a backtick `git status`) into done-oracle.ts -> contract exited 1 flagging done-oracle.ts:74 alias violation; reverted -> exited 0. Both gaming shapes turn it RED.
